t: Vim Regex Recipes for Fixing Google Docs Markdown Exports
s: This article provides Vim/Neovim regex commands to automate cleanup of common formatting issues from Google Docs Markdown exports, focusing on footnotes, backslashes, and pipes. It emphasizes practical workflow enhancements like confirmation (`c` flag) and resume (`.,$`) ranges.
sub: Automating footnote number formatting with `<sup>` tags
Removing excessive backslashes before Markdown punctuation
Escaping pipe characters (`|`) in citation titles
Tagging ambiguous inline footnotes with confirmation
